use_when: to let people choose from a small set of options, such as Pace, Feeling or Tone.
Use single select when only one answer fits. Selecting one chip unselects the others.
Use multi select when more than one answer can apply.
Place chips under a short question or label, so people know what they are choosing.

dont_use_when.use_instead: a link or the header navigation

dont_use_when.when: to start an action, such as submitting a form.
Do not put more than about 8 chips in one group.
Do not use the selected color for anything except the chosen option.

best_practice: Keep labels short, one to three words.
Use the same chip on mobile and website. It is 40px tall on both.
Keep the same options in the same order on every platform.

variant_intent.selected=true: Figma: turn Selected on for the chosen option.
variant_intent.selected=false: An option that is not chosen.
variant_intent.state=Default: Lets hover and focus happen naturally (code).
variant_intent.state=Hover: Pins the hover look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Focused: Pins the focus look, for docs and QA (code).

placement: Place chips under a short question or label, so people know what they are choosing.

a11y.fact: Renders a native <button> with aria-pressed set from selected.
A disabled chip is natively disabled.
Shows a focus ring on keyboard focus.
